# @id: memory-bomb
# @title: Memory exhaustion
# @expect: Memory Limit Exceeded
# @sr: SR-4
# @summary: Allocates 50 MB chunks and touches every page until the cgroup memory limit stops it.
hoard = []
mb = 0
while True:
    block = bytearray(50 * 1024 * 1024)   # 50 MB
    for i in range(0, len(block), 4096):  # touch every page so it is really resident
        block[i] = 1
    hoard.append(block)
    mb += 50
    print(f"holding {mb} MB", flush=True)

# @id: host-files
# @title: Read host files & secrets
# @expect: Security Violation
# @sr: SR-9
# @summary: Hunts for the host's home directories, password files, the Podman socket and platform secrets.
import os

targets = ["/Users", "/home", "/root", "/run/podman/podman.sock", "/var/run/docker.sock",
           "/run/secrets", "/proc/1/environ", "/etc/shadow"]
for t in targets:
    try:

            entries = os.listdir(t)
            print(f"[{'!!' if entries else 'ok'}] {t}: listing = {entries}{'' if entries else ' (empty)'}")
        else:

print("\n/etc/passwd inside the sandbox (the image's own file, not the host's):")
print(open("/etc/passwd").read())

# @id: priv-esc
# @title: Gain root / escalate privileges
# @expect: Security Violation
# @sr: SR-2, SR-10
# @summary: Checks its identity and capabilities, looks for setuid binaries, then tries setuid(0), chroot and mount.
import ctypes
import os

print(f"uid={os.getuid()} euid={os.geteuid()} gid={os.getgid()}")
for line in open("/proc/self/status"):
    if line.startswith(("CapEff", "CapPrm", "CapBnd", "NoNewPrivs", "Seccomp")):
        print("  " + line.strip())

suid = [os.path.join(d, f) for d in ("/bin", "/usr/bin", "/sbin", "/usr/sbin") if os.path.isdir(d)
        for f in os.listdir(d) if os.stat(os.path.join(d, f), follow_symlinks=False).st_mode & 0o6000]
print("setuid/setgid binaries:", suid or "none")
print("sudo/su present:", any(os.path.exists(p) for p in ("/usr/bin/sudo", "/bin/su", "/usr/bin/su")))

libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
r = libc.mount(b"none", b"/mnt", b"tmpfs", 0, None)
print(f"mount tmpfs -> {r} (errno {ctypes.get_errno()}: {os.strerror(ctypes.get_errno())})")
try:
    os.chroot("/")
except Exception as e:
    print("chroot ->", e)

# The escalation itself. Nothing catches this.
os.setuid(0)
print("I AM ROOT")

# @id: cross-submission
# @title: Spy on other submissions
# @expect: Security Violation
# @sr: SR-9, FR-2
# @summary: Looks for other sandboxes' processes, files and IPC, and tries to kill everything it can see.
import os
import signal

pids = sorted(int(p) for p in os.listdir("/proc") if p.isdigit())
print(f"processes visible in my PID namespace: {pids}")
for p in pids:
    try:
        cmd = open(f"/proc/{p}/cmdline", "rb").read().replace(b"\0", b" ").decode().strip()
    except Exception as e:
        cmd = f"<{type(e).__name__}>"
    print(f"  pid {p}: {cmd or '<hidden>'}")

print("files in /sandbox:", os.listdir("/sandbox"))
print("files in /tmp:", os.listdir("/tmp"))
print("hostname:", os.uname().nodename)
print("SysV shared memory:", open("/proc/sysvipc/shm").read().strip().splitlines()[1:] or "none")

# Try to kill the sandbox supervisor (PID 1), then every PID up to 32768.
for target in [1] + list(range(2, 32768)):
    if target == os.getpid():
        continue
    try:
        os.kill(target, signal.SIGKILL)
    except ProcessLookupError:
        pass
print("still alive after the kill sweep; nothing outside this sandbox was reachable")

# Last resort: reach into the supervisor and the filesystem behind it. Nothing catches this.
open("/proc/1/root/sandbox/main.py").read()
